# FG-GIT-0019

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`repo-maintenance`](../../ops/runbooks/repo-maintenance.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `fsck_reports_corruption` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: リポジトリの整合性の確認で問題が見つかりました。問い合わせ番号を添えて管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The integrity check of the repository found a problem. Contact the administrator with the request ID.
- id: Pemeriksaan integritas repositori menemukan masalah. Hubungi administrator dengan menyertakan ID permintaan.

## 原因 (cause)

`git fsck` of the maintenance job (M3 O3: `--connectivity-only` with every run, a full check once per `maintenance.fsck_interval_days`) exited non-zero: an object a ref (or a merge request version ref) reaches is missing or unreadable, or (full) an object is malformed. Clones of the affected history, merges and the browse API can fail on that object. Never caused by a user action alone: storage (disk, file system, a restore that missed files), a process killed mid-write outside forge's own steps, or a manual change in the bare repository.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

One alert event `forge.git.maintenance_completed` with `outcome=corrupt`, `error_code`, `repo_id`, `mode` (`connectivity` / `full`), `exit_code`, `findings` (the number of lines fsck printed), `first_finding` and the head of `stdout` / `stderr` (object ids and ref names only, never content). The ledger row has `outcome = 'corrupt'`, `error_code = 'FG-GIT-0019'`; doctor `repositories.integrity` lists every repository whose last fsck failed. Confirm read-only: `git -C <path> fsck --connectivity-only --no-dangling` (and `--full` for a malformed object), `git -C <path> cat-file -t <id>` for each finding.

## 対処 (fix)

Do not run gc or prune on the repository (it would drop what may still be recoverable) — the maintenance job itself does not prune a repository whose fsck failed. Follow runbook repo-maintenance: find the objects in a clone (developers' clones, the GitLab mirror, the last backup) and bring them back with an approved step; then run `forge admin repo maintain <repo_id>` and check that `repositories.integrity` is clean.
